svg.aria-label: Comparing the iris codes of two different eyes
svg.text: How two iris codes are compared

g.text: code B: 1,312 usable bits (eyelashes cover the top)
two images of the same eye differ
in a few percent of the bits

svg.text: Real codes from the SDK (iris-v2), compared bit by bit without alignment. The matcher also tries small rotations and reports the best score.
